assessment_objectives.objective: the individuals or roles responsible for operating each control evidenced by Control Assurance Automation (CAA) are identified and documented.
the individuals or roles authorized to modify Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection, transformation or scoring logic are identified and documented.

access controls prevent an individual responsible for operating a control from modifying the Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection, transformation or scoring logic used to evidence that control without independent approval (e.g., enforced peer review, protected branches or a separate deployment role).
separation of duties between control operation and Control Assurance Automation (CAA) logic modification is reviewed at a defined frequency and when personnel or role assignments change.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change

assessment_objectives.objective: where separation of duties cannot be achieved, compensating controls (e.g., independent review of all Control Assurance Automation (CAA) logic changes) are documented and approved.
